name.ja: 1/1000 宇宙戦艦ヤマト3199（第3次改装型：参戦章叙勲式典記念塗装）
name.en: 1/1000 Space Battleship Yamato 3199 (Third Renovation Type: Painting to Commemorate the Battle Medal Awarding Ceremony)

description.ja: 『ヤマトよ永遠に REBEL3199』から第3次改装型：参戦章叙勲式典記念塗装のヤマトが1/1000スケールでいよいよ登場！
description.en: The 3rd renovated version from "Yamato Forever REBEL3199": Yamato commemorating the battle medal award ceremony is finally available in 1/1000 Scale!

description.ja: • 船首の錨マークは凸モールドで再現。細部までこだわった精密なディテールと水転写式デカールで参戦章叙勲式典記念塗装を表現できる。
description.en: • The anchor mark on the bow is reproduced with a convex mold. Precise details and water transfer decals allow you to express the commemorative painting of the combat medal ceremony.

description.ja: • 特徴的な甲板色はパーツ分けと一部デカールにより表現。
description.en: • The distinctive deck color is expressed by dividing the parts and some decals.

description.ja: • 艦載機であるコスモタイガーII(単座)、コスモタイガーII(三座)が付属。
description.en: • Carrier-based aircraft Cosmo Tiger II (single seat) and Cosmo Tiger II (three seat) are included.

description.ja: • ディスプレイ用の台座が付属。
• パーツとデカールの選択で2205版の再現が可能。
description.en: • It is possible to reproduce the 2205 version by selecting parts and decals.

accessories.ja: 錨レリーフ艦首パーツ×1
